Twelve meals feed 18 people, so each meal feeds 1.5 people. Feeding 12 people takes 12 / 1.5 = 8 meals.

Solution A reaches 8. Solution B misreads the setup: it treats each meal as 1.5 portions and divides 18 by 1.5, which has no basis in the problem, and its arithmetic is also wrong, since 18 × 2/3 = 12 is only a coincidence of the setup.

WINNER: A
